description: blueteam-accounting's rules for fabric-pr arm. The repository is BlueTeam OÜ's private accounting working repository, kept by its accountant-ee holder: calendar, close notes, working papers and the filing record; the books themselves are in SmartAccounts. It has no build. boundary.paths: the harness wiring (.claude/, .mcp.json, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md and AGENTS.md at any depth, which steer the sessions, and any .gitignore, which keeps exports and env files out), CI (.github/), an environment file at any depth (.env*), a certificate or key file (*.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.pfx, *.asc, *.gpg, *.crt, *.cer, *.der, .ssh/, id_rsa/id_ecdsa/id_ed25519, .netrc, .pgpass, *.kdbx, *.ovpn), and the words secret, credential, token and key anywhere. boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/ or .github/, never for an instruction file or .gitignore, and never for a path that matches a sensitive pattern in any letter case (the guard is (?i:...), as paths is compiled case-insensitively): Markdown, which is the notes and working papers, and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary. No direct-to-main rule: every change is a pull request. Written 2026-11-17, at registration (job j924).
